name: Coffee (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Coffee (Coffea) [Coffee and coffee products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central / SR Legacy NDB 14209 'Coffee, brewed from grounds, prepared with tap water'
Rune, Giacalone, Steen et al. 2023, Current Research in Food Science 6:100485, doi:10.1016/j.crfs.2023.100485 (individual organic acids & sugars in French-press brewed coffee)
Konieczka et al. 2020, LWT (S0023643820303339) and Wu et al. 2023 (trigonelline in coffee brews)
provenance.curation_notes: For a growth medium, brewed coffee is a dilute (~99% water), nitrogen-poor beverage whose dominant carbon/energy substrates are ORGANIC ACIDS — chlorogenic and quinic acids first, then acetic, citric, formic, lactic, malic — with only modest free glucose/fructose that survive roasting (light roasts only). Caffeine (~40 mg/100 mL) and trigonelline (~50 mg/100 mL) are abundant but largely non-nutritive/inhibitory. Potassium is the main mineral. Acid/sugar amounts come from a specialty French-press

curation_removed.name: Cholesterol
curation_removed.reason: Animal sterol; biologically implausible in a plant-derived beverage; FooDB predicted, not measured.

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed (animal-form) vitamin A; USDA reports 0 in brewed coffee; implausible in a plant beverage.

curation_removed.name: Beta-Carotene
curation_removed.reason: USDA reports negligible/zero provitamin A carotenoid in brewed coffee; FooDB predicted.

curation_removed.name: Cyanocobalamin
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin B12 is not synthesised by plants; not present in coffee; FooDB predicted/implausible.

curation_removed.name: Phytomenadione
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin K1; USDA reports 0 in brewed coffee; negligible in the brew.

curation_removed.name: L-Ascorbate
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin C; USDA reports 0 in brewed coffee; heat/roast-labile and absent from the beverage.

curation_removed.name: Starch C12H20O10
curation_removed.reason: No starch is extracted into the brewed beverage (retained in the grounds); USDA carbohydrate ~0.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Ultratrace, non-nutritive in this matrix; FooDB contaminant-level entry, not a growth nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt ion at ultratrace/contaminant level; not a defined growth nutrient of the brew.

curation_removed.name: Decanoic acid / Dodecanoic acid / Pentadecanoic acid / Octanoic acid / Heptanoate / Hexanoate / alpha-Linolenic acid / (Z,Z)-9,12-octadecadienoic acid / C18:1 n-9
curation_removed.reason: Filtered brewed coffee contains ~0.02 g/100 g total lipid; these green-bean fatty acids are almost entirely retained in the grounds/paper filter and are not meaningful growth substrates in the brew.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
